comment: Talos audit baselines (Batch 2). Measured values are reference points captured 2026-10-31; warnAt/failAt are regression gates. Entries marked referenceOnly are recorded for the dashboard but never compared (counts and wall-clock approximations vary by machine). WARN on breach of warnAt; FAIL (exit 1) on breach of failAt.

ui.distBytes.description: Total apps/ui/dist bytes (mirrors thresholds.maxDistBytes; fail at 8 MiB)

ui.mainJsGzipBytes.description: Largest non-void-neon asset JS, gzip estimate (mirrors thresholds.maxMainJsGzipBytes)

ui.voidNeonChunkGzipBytes.description: Largest void-neon* lazy chunk, gzip estimate (lazy-load budget: warn 350 KiB, fail 450 KiB)

startup.toolchainProbeMs.description: Time to resolve node/pnpm/cargo/rustc/git --version (startup readiness probe)

swarm.totalDurationMs.description: Sum of the ten agent durations per swarm run

telemetry.suiteMs.description: cargo test -p talos_telemetry -p cost_tracker --lib, warm cache (overhead gate: 1k span records cost microseconds vs ms-scale ops; suite must stay far below warn)

telemetry.instrumentationSites.description: record_now call sites across the 7 instrumented crates (reference, 2026-11-01)

telemetry.costDriftUsd.description: Max |tracked - expected| cost drift; suites assert exactness to 1e-9 (any drift fails telemetry-tests first)

tests.root.description: node:test cases at repo root smoke (reference, 2026-10-31)

build.uiSeconds.description: Wall-clock pnpm build approximation, warm cache (reference, 2026-10-31)

perf.spawnP95Ms.description: Harness p95 node-spawn floor, 25 runs (cold-start proxy floor; P3 target 3000ms)

perf.eventCommitP95Ms.description: Harness p95 1000-event feed commit, 25 runs (interaction proxy; P3 target 100ms)

perf.frameP95Ms.description: Harness p95 per-frame scene-update sim, 25 runs x 120 frames (frame-budget proxy; P3 target 8ms)

perf.topologyBuildP95Ms.description: Harness p95 topology-build mirror, 25 runs (selector-path proxy; real code p95 0.563ms in topology.perf.test.ts)

perf.idleRssMB.description: Harness node RSS after workload (RAM proxy; P3 target 600MB idle)

ui.coldStartP95Ms.description: Real Tauri cold-start p95 UNMEASURED headless (P3 target 3000ms); local-measured method owed (WP-012C). Zero is a placeholder, never a claim.

ui.installerBytes.description: Installer bytes UNMEASURED without a signed build (P3 target 60MB); local method in docs/PERFORMANCE.md. Zero is a placeholder, never a claim.
